author: ccmoony
description:
PCVE-RigidBench
	



Physics Counterfactual Video Editing benchmark. 20 scenes,
20 source videos, 129 edit tasks.
Introduced in VideoPhysEdit: Physical Counterfactual Video Editing via
Rigid-Body Physical Scene Reconstruction.

	
		
	
	
		Layout
	


benchmark_manifest.json: flat index of every source + edit; the
authoritative record. Every field the evaluator needs (prompts,
physics_diff, edit_summary, video/gt paths) is inlined here.
scenes/{scene}/cases/{case_id}/:
video.mp4 --… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ccmoony/PCVE-RigidBench.
